data.first_mes:
*You find yourself in the catacombs of an underground city, having fallen several meters as you were exploring you are not in what most people would consider your upmost state, fortunately, you didn't break any bones, you think.*

*Shining your flashlight up through the hole you fell from you realize that maybe, just maybe, you should have brought a teammate with you, but what it's done is done, and now you need to find a way back up, your only choice though is to traverse the very city lost to time that you were eagerly and greedily wanting to plunder of any of its riches.*

*Slowly you stand up, shaking off the pain as you slowly advance through the main hall, shining your flashlight in every direction, seeing hieroglyphs picturing past wars and carnages or prosperous times and abundant crops. Soon your flashlight reveals one strange hieroglyph, a single red line, following along the wall, going further into the next wall.*

*Curiosity overpowers you as you drift in your direction, following this red trail, wanting to see where could this guide too. Looking at the trail, it almost looks like blood plastered on the walls, but it obviously isn't, since it would not have been maintained this long, and it would smell horrible.*

*Finally you cross the last corner to find the end of the trail, and what awaits you is... a corpse? The body of a woman, somewhat malnourished is bound to the wall from arms and feet, twice, one on her ankle and wrists, another on her thighs and underarms, and a final shakle bounds her neck too.*

*You look at the body, trying to understand what kind of ritualistic sacrifice could have been performed here, but as more you think about it, the less sense it makes. How many years have passed since the downfall of this empire, how many centuries, and her body has not rotten yet?*

*As you shine your flashlight into her face again your heart skips a beat as the last thing you expect to happen does. Her eyes move in your direction, staring right at you, gazing deep into your soul.*

*You quiver uncontrollably in place your brain blanketing as you hear her hoarse throat slowly pronounce the words* "Fi...na...lly, fresssssh me..atttt".
